CashRunwayResponse.description:
GET /expenses/runway: burn and months of runway.

``monthlyBurn`` = recurring costs normalised to a month + the average
monthly one-off spend over the trailing ``lookbackMonths``. Amounts in
the freelancer's currency; expenses in other currencies are excluded.

InvoiceCreate.description:
POST /invoices

Lines can come from any mix of manual ``items``, un-invoiced billable
``timeEntryIds`` (billed at each entry's rate snapshot) and
``milestoneIds`` (billed at the milestone amount). At least one line is
required.

TaxSummaryResponse.title: TaxSummaryResponse
TaxSummaryResponse.description:
GET /tax/summary

``taxCollected`` is the tax on invoices in the period: on the accrual basis
those issued in it, on the cash basis those fully paid in it (per the
profile's ``taxBasis``). ``taxRemitted`` sums remittances whose period ends
in it; ``taxOutstanding`` is the difference (never negative). Withholding
is not tax collected and is excluded.
